sources.name: Lake Serene
sources.use: identity, endpoint and statistics only; no copied geometry
sources.finding: Lake-only distance is 7.2 miles round trip; the 8.2-mile header includes Bridal Veil Falls. The guide describes a large rock along the shore. The manifest uses named Lunch Rock and omits the falls spur.
sources.gainBasis: not explicitly stated; distance label does not prove gain basis

sources.name: Tolmie Peak
sources.finding: NPS states usual access to Mowich Lake from SR165 is unavailable because of the Fairfax Bridge closure. Other hiking access does not validate this trailhead approach.

officialMetrics.title: Alpine Lakes Wilderness: Recreation Allocation Study (2025)
officialMetrics.finding: All three metrics are retained. Colchuck’s first-shore candidate is shorter than the paper’s stated hike; no endpoint is moved to make the values agree.
